* Euclid (fl. 300 BC): Known as the "Father of Geometry" for his book "Elements", which systematized the study of geometry.

* René Descartes (1596-1650): Known as the "Father of Analytic Geometry" for his work on coordinate geometry.
* Blaise Pascal (1623-1662): Known as the "Father of Probability Theory" for his work on probability and statistics.

However, if I had to choose one person who is most commonly referred to as the "Father of Mathematics", I would say it's Archimedes.
